{{Top|leg}}
A '''solocorn''' was a mythical creature of the [[Tythan]]s in the [[Pre-Republic era]]. It was capable of a prancing gait. It resembled a [[Shire]] with veined wings, and a single horn.

During her time training under the [[Je'daii]] [[Ter'cay]] at [[Qigong Kesh]], [[Lanoree Brock]] successfully created a [[Mind trick#Force illusion|Force illusion]] of a solocorn, which Ter'cay commented was easy to do by virtue that it was a figure of the imagination.
